integrity: The proof gives an analytical Hilbert--Schmidt comparison to a Wiener--Hopf model; deterministic finite computations are supplementary, and publication priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Fredholm essential spectrum and off-boundary index on complex H^2 only. Nonzero self-crossings classified for positive integer b; general real b intersections, isolated eigenvalues, full spectrum and H^p extensions are not determined.
title: Fredholm beta curves and exact real crossings for generalized Hilbert operators
